portal.name: BetterTago
portal.paletteNote: Settled 2026-08-09, and derived from BetterTago's OWN delivered mark: brandColor is the emblem's deep green and anchors primary-700; accentColor is the mark's sun and anchors accent-400. It stays DELIBERATELY INDEPENDENT of the municipality's own visual identity — visual similarity to official material would imply an endorsement this project does not have. Do not derive these from tago.gov.ph, and do not use the municipal seal anywhere without written permission. Stated rather than left to be found: the mark's channels are abstracted from municipal motifs, so painting a whole site from it amplifies that derivation from a logo to a site. That belongs in the conversation with the municipality, and it is not settled here.
portal.tagline: The Municipality of Tago's public information, made findable.

history.separatedFrom: the municipality that is now Tandag City

officialSite.note: The authoritative record. Where this portal and the official site disagree, the official site is right and this portal is wrong.

emergency.note: No municipal emergency hotline is published on tago.gov.ph. SETTLED POSITION (2026-08-09): the emergency surface renders that absence rather than a number, and will not carry a neighbouring municipality's number, an undated one, or a plausible guess. This is the position, not a temporary state — a wrong number in an emergency is worse than no number at all. If numbers are obtained later they are recorded with the office that supplied them and the date, and the surface changes then. See docs/governance.md.

pending.lgu.district: Not published on the official site. Obtain from the national elections commission or the Sanggunian.
pending.lgu.psgc: Not published on the official site. Obtain from the national statistics agency's PSGC release.
pending.lgu.postalCode: The official contact page publishes 1101, which sits outside the range used for Surigao del Sur and appears to belong to a different part of the country. HELD: do not publish it, and do not 'correct' it to a guess. Confirm against the postal service's own record, then tell the municipality if their published value is a typo.
pending.lgu.incomeClass: Not published on the official site. Obtain from the finance department's income-classification issuance.
pending.lgu.coordinates: Not published on the official site. Obtain from the national statistics agency or a cited gazetteer; needed before any map ships.
pending.lgu.landAreaKm2: Not published on the official site. Obtain from the national statistics agency alongside the population figure; a land area with no cited source is exactly the kind of plausible number this register exists to keep out.
pending.lgu.barangayCount: Not published on the official site, and neither is the barangay list. Both are a Phase 0 request and a national-statistics-agency cross-check.
pending.lgu.population: Obtain from the national statistics agency's census release, cited by census year.
pending.lgu.households: Obtain from the same census release as the population figure.
pending.lgu.censusYear: Set in the same change that sets population and households; a figure without its census year is not citable.
pending.contact.municipalHall.mapUrl: No map link is published. Confirm the hall's actual location in person before publishing one — a wrong pin costs a resident a fare.
pending.contact.municipalHall.email: The official contact page publishes one address at a free consumer mail provider for the Office of the Mayor. Confirm it is the channel the office wants published before republishing it.
pending.contact.municipalHall.officeHours: Not stated anywhere on the official site. A phone number with no stated hours is a coin toss, and a directory without them sends people to locked doors. This is Phase 0 request #3.
pending.contact.project.email: There is now a stated reason to publish one, and this is the honest gap it leaves open. The correction channel is the public repository's issue tracker — live, linked from the footer of every page, and requiring a free account on a code-hosting site. That account is a real barrier for exactly the resident most likely to spot a wrong fee at a counter, and the governance standard asks for a channel usable with no code account. Closing this needs an address that exists and someone reading it; it needs no code, because the footer link is already null-guarded. Recorded in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/governance.md rather than left to be noticed.
pending.socials.municipalFacebook: A Facebook page exists and is referenced from the official contact page; capture the exact URL.
